production.note: US model years 2011-2014. Start: Dodge release '2011 Dodge Challenger SRT8® 392 Debuts with Newest HEMI® V-8'. 2012: Dodge release 'New High-tech Features Boost 2012 Dodge Challenger SRT8® 392's Overall Performance' (dodge-challenger-srt8-392-release-2012). End: J.D. Power lists a '2014 Dodge Challenger Coupe 2D SRT-8 V8' at 470 hp (jdpower-challenger-srt8-2014); for 2015 the 392 car was renamed SRT 392 (485 hp), mentioned in the existing Challenger R/T Scat Pack record. No Dodge page stating 2014 as the last SRT8 year was opened. The 2014 end year rests on a database.

displacementL.note: Dodge 2012 specifications: 'Displacement 392 cu. in. (6,424 cu. cm)'; Dodge's 2015-on sheets give the same 392 cu in engine as 6,417 cc. 6.4 either way.

transmission.note: 'TRANSMISSION: SIX-SPEED MANUAL TREMEC TR-6060 with ZF-SACHS 240 MM TWIN-DISC CLUTCH' and 'TRANSMISSION: W5A580 FIVE-SPEED AUTOMATIC'. The 2011 release: 'the standard Tremec TR-6060 six-speed manual transmission'; the 2012 release: 'The optional five-speed automatic transmission'.

powerHp.note: Quote (Dodge 2011 release): "Pumping out 470 horsepower and 470 lb.-ft. of torque". Dodge 2012 release: "The 392-cubic inch (6.4-liter) HEMI® V-8 delivers 470 horsepower (351 kW)" (dodge-challenger-srt8-392-release-2012); the 2012 specification sheet prints "Power (estimated SAE net) 470 bhp (351 kW) @ 6,000 rpm (73.4 bhp/L)" (dodge-challenger-srt8-392-specs-2012). Cars.com 2011 SRT8 "470 @ 6000" (cars-com-challenger-srt8-2011), KBB 2013 and J.D. Power 2014 the same (kbb-challenger-srt8-392-2013, jdpower-challenger-srt8-2014): 470 hp for the whole run.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL (manufacturer estimate). Six-speed manual. Quote (Dodge 2012 specifications, 'DIMENSIONS AND CAPACITIES'): "Curb Weight, lb. (kg)—Est. 4,160 (automatic)" "4,170 (manual)". Cars.com 2011 '2dr Cpe SRT8' "Base Curb Weight 4,170 lbs" (cars-com-challenger-srt8-2011) and J.D. Power 2014 "4,170 lbs" (jdpower-challenger-srt8-2014) match the estimate exactly and are counted as copies of it; KBB 2013 SRT8 392 (Automatic): "Curb Weight | 4160 lbs." matches the automatic estimate (kbb-challenger-srt8-392-2013). Dodge's 2011 specification PDF could not be read. Reference year 2011 (launch year); the 2012 estimate is for the unchanged car.

provisionalNote: Weight (4,170 lb, manual) rests on Dodge's 2012 specification sheet, where it is labelled 'Est.'; Cars.com and J.D. Power repeat the same figure and count as copies. A final Dodge figure (a readable 2011, 2013 or 2014 SRT8 392 specification sheet without an estimate label) or a major magazine spec panel would replace it. Power is from Dodge releases.
